text: Rabia Qadir holds account PK**UNIL****9281 opened on 3 March 2022. The subject is a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 1 August 2026 and 10 August 2026, the account received 25 credits totalling PKR 1,240,000 and made 5 debits totalling PKR 1,179,000. All 25 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 23 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 10 August 2026, scoring a typology MULE-01 of 360 against a threshold of 300. The presence of 23 distinct inbound senders in a short period is consistent with the red flag of many unrelated inbound senders. Debits equal to 95% of credits with a median of 4.2 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggest most inbound value leaves the account within hours. Credits in the activity window were 49.6 times the declared monthly income of PKR 25,000, which is inconsistent with the subject's Student profile. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 713,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 466,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 28 August 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
